svg.text: SOCCER ROBOT / OPTIONAL SENSORS AND GATE SIGNAL
Shared map for both driver profiles. Signals use Uno 5 V logic; follow printed module labels.
SENSOR POWER: Uno 5V → all identified sensor VCC; Uno GND → all sensor GND.
Use a low-current distribution rail. Servo red comes from HW-140 5 V DIRECTLY, not this sensor rail.
Gate orange/yellow → D9; gate red → HW-140 5 V; gate brown → power ground.
Normally-open start button → D3 and GND; no external resistor (INPUT_PULLUP).
Color LED control left unconnected pending module confirmation; color-reading code is not implemented.
Bluetooth and unidentified square converter: leave disconnected until their ratings/pins are identified.
D0/D1 reserved for Serial/upload. A4/A5 occupied: do not also connect I2C peripherals there.
sensor_test: battery motor/gate branch OFF; computer USB powers Uno/sensors. IR enabled by default.
Ultrasonic NA = no valid echo, not a clear path. Color and ultrasonic hardware remain unverified.
robot_bench uses motor/gate timing only. Connected sensors do not provide navigation or obstacle avoidance.
Gate motion and wheel PWM are independent. Servo Timer1 does not affect wheel PWM on D5/D6.
Read CONNECTIONS.md and POWER.md before assembling. Both driver profiles preserve these sensor assignments.
